quotedPost.originalText:
I tried creating motion graphics with Claude Opus 5.5… and this is the result 🤯

From yesterday, bit by bit  about 1 hour of work in total.

I made a 3D animation using the NVIDIA Blackwell GPU as the subject:

→ Enter the data center
→ Open the server
→ Disassemble the GPU
→ Go deeper into the chip
→ Pass through circuits & transistors
→ All the way down to a single silicon atom

And the crazy part?

This entire 3D motion graphic runs in a **single HTML file, directly in the browser. 😭

It’s honestly wild that Claude Opus 5.5 can help create something like this in roughly an hour.

Opus 5.5 is seriously insane. 🤯🔥

post.originalText:
One prompt to Claude Opus 5.5 on High:

“Show me what goes on inside an AI data centre.”

35 minutes later → a 2.5-minute 3D film, going from the power grid all the way down to Blackwell silicon.

One HTML file.
Zero 3D assets.
And it cost me just ~7% of my usage. 🤯

This is getting ridiculous.
